items.detail: The 16 business operations are now named and mapped, but they intentionally return authenticated 501 problem responses until application use cases, persisted entities and policy enforcement are implemented.

Application ports now have concrete registrations, but external provider adapters remain fail-closed placeholders. Implement real authorization, audit, idempotency, transaction/outbox, Blob, Graph, Search and notification adapters; verify identity isolation.

Worker NotImplementedException stubs were removed, but promotion, hash verification, event consumption, SLA evaluation, capture/notification/retention and outbox processing still require production use-case bindings and replay tests.

The production entry point no longer imports PrototypeApp, but the UI still uses development service flows. Connect the production UI to Entra and generated API contracts; retain prototype only as an explicitly separate demo.
Front Door routes all traffic to the static web origin. Implement and validate the approved private API ingress design, gateway/backend path mapping and frontend origin restrictions.

Complete API/SPA app registrations, scopes, app roles, tenant federation and consent; reconcile SQL workload principal names with the six Bicep identities and verify worker identity selection per workload.

Rehearse the canonical SQL package in an isolated database; verify all contained principals, client taxonomy/holidays/retention, reporting RLS and upgrade compatibility. Provide versioned upgrade migrations and tested restore/rollback evidence.

Resolve blank-subscription bootstrap ordering: the template creates ACR and immediately starts the API by digest, before the image is imported. Rehearse private runner connectivity, Function package deployment, Search schema and Power BI tenant provisioning.

Run backend tests with SDK 10.0.401 and add connected service integration, authorization-negative, promotion replay, deployment/rollback and restore tests. Prototype browser tests do not verify these integrations.

Complete artifact signing/provenance and SBOM/scanning gates, validate release scripts against a disposable target, wire the production release pipeline and retain named approval plus rollback rehearsal evidence.

Replace stale Node/PostgreSQL/Redis operational references with tested .NET/Azure SQL v1.3 procedures; reconcile prototype behavior with the manual-classification baseline and resolve outstanding client decisions.
